name: dither-field

frames.best_why: Bright bloom near the pointer makes the purple dithered horizon and its square dots clearly visible.

tagline: Purple dithered light haze that brightens under the pointer.
summary: A full-bleed background of purple light rendered as crisp square dots, glowing like a horizon and blooming around the mouse. It can also dither an image or video, and it holds overlaid page content.
appearance: A full-width dark stage washed in purple light that reads as a horizon glow, brightening to near-white near the bottom centre. The surface is built from tiny square dithered dots rather than smooth gradients, densest where the light is brightest, with a loose band of haze across the middle.
behaviour: The glow drifts and flickers slowly on its own and brightens strongly around the mouse, pen or a held finger, easing back after the pointer. It pauses when scrolled out of view or when the tab is hidden; the demo centres a headline, paragraph and two buttons over it.
demo_content: Overlaid headline 'Light, rendered one dot at a time', a short paragraph, and Get started / Learn more buttons.
use_when: A landing page wants a rich animated backdrop that feels technical and reacts to the cursor without heavy artwork.
avoid_when: It needs WebGL2 and a sized parent, falls back to a static CSS dot pattern on old devices, and never fully settles.
customise: Pattern, image or video src, colour ramp, dot size, intensity, speed, fps and interactive are props; custom patterns and the shaders need source edits. Children sit above the dots.
weight_why: A WebGL2 shader loop runs every frame and rebuilds mipmaps; it pauses off-screen or on a hidden tab.

a11y.note: The dot canvas is aria-hidden and decorative; it pauses under reduced motion or a hidden tab, needing WebGL2 or a CSS dot fallback.

issues: The glow saturates to flat white at its brightest, wiping out the dot texture.
The grey paragraph text sits on a bright purple glow and is low contrast in places.
polish_why: Striking dithered glow with a convincing pointer reaction; the brightest bloom washes out the dots.
